name: 1983 Soviet nuclear false alarm incident
short_desc: Stanislav Petrov treats a Soviet satellite warning of incoming US missiles as a false alarm.
date_note: 26 September 1983. The warning was false; this entry does not assume that a nuclear launch would otherwise have been automatic.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
